Sam: Heads-up from onboarding calls: three pilots asking for a low-friction burst buffer per-route. They explicitly want self-serve toggle + predictable billing.

Rina: Important decision: is this an "operational addon" (metered throughput buffer) or a permanent tier bump? Customers care about start/stop control.

Carlos: From infra: addon is doable but we need a placement policy to avoid noisy-neighboring heavy routes. That implies a scheduling hint in the API.

Nora: Sales input: customers prefer addon if unit price is obvious. They hate opaque credits. Also legal asks a rollback credit if burst degrades SLAs.

Sam: Quick draft of pricing shapes: flat monthly hold + per-burst-second rate OR pay-as-you-go per-token burst. Which is simpler for pilots?

Rina: Simplicity wins. Suggest: small monthly seat + per-token burst in increments of 10k tokens. Example: $200/mo hold + $0.0004/token during bursts. Adds predictable baseline.

Carlos: Implementation note: need an SDK flag and route-level metadata: {"burst_enabled": true, "burst_capacity": 100000}. Also a server-side enforcement for over-alloc.

perf-bot: perf-test: baseline 1k concurrent routes ok. Addon simulation pending config.

Nora: LegalBot, confirm if rollback credits acceptable and what language we need?

LegalBot: We need: definition of "burst window", limits per-account, and explicit non-guarantee of uninterrupted availability during bursts. Also require customer not to use bursts for continuous baseline load.

Sam: Ok. Proposed launch criteria: 1) Spec + API toggle 2) Pricing model published 3) Pilot UX in console (on/off + capacity slider) 4) Infra spike tests with p99 goal <= 25% degradation 5) Contract template w/ rollback credit clause.

Rina: Also capture tooling: billing preview modal and invoice line item mapping. billing-bot, can you show sample invoice line for addon?

billing-bot: sample: "Elastic Burst Addon": Hold $200/mo, Burst usage 50,000 tokens @ $0.0004 = $20. Total add-on = $220.

Carlos: Dev effort estimate: API + console toggle (6 dev-days), scheduler changes (4 dev-days), perf harness (2 perf-days).

Nora: Sales asks we do a 2-customer low-touch pilot first, then open to self-serve. Pilot metrics: adoption time, billing clarity feedback, and incident counts.

Sam: Decision: move forward as metered addon with a small monthly hold. Run infra spike and legal review in parallel. If perf/ops costs > expected, we'll revisit tier approach. Owners: Rina (pricing + RFC), Carlos (impl + spike), Nora (pilot + legal coordination). Target RFC: 1757700000.

Rina: I'll put numbers into RFC and mock console wireframe.

Carlos: Kicking off infra spike tomorrow. Ping me with sample traces.

Nora: I'll reach out to two pilot customers for opt-in.

LegalBot: I'll draft clause and flag for review.

perf-bot: perf run queued: branch feat/elastic-burst-sim 10:00 UTC.

Sam: Great. Keep it lean: minimal UI, clear price, rollback credit spec. :rocket:

billing-bot: billing config ticket created: BILL-4782.
